response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_h, o.overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN ov o WHERE p.avg_h > o.overall), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS kept_mean FROM kept), r AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_h AS avg_humidity, k.avg_h - k.overall AS excess_over_overall, k.avg_h - m.kept_mean AS diff_from_kept_mean, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k.avg_h - m.kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM kept k CROSS JOIN km m WHERE m.kept_mean IS NOT NULL AND k.overall IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_overall, diff_from_kept_mean FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, equipref

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the unweighted mean of the per-equipment average humidities. Equipment whose readings are all NULL has a NULL average and is excluded from that mean. It is not the mean over all readings.
Rows tied with the 10th are included by ranking with RANK() on the difference from the kept-equipment mean. Equipment reference is used only as a tiebreaker for display order.
